output: html_document

```{r}
library(mlogit)
library(here)
source(here("R", "log_loss.R"))

# ==========================================
# 1. LOAD AND PREPARE DATA
# ==========================================
train <- read.csv(here("data", "train.csv"))
test  <- read.csv(here("data", "test.csv"))

train$Choice <- max.col(train[, c("Ch1","Ch2","Ch3","Ch4")])
test$Choice  <- 1L

# Establish a shared validation split (80/20)
set.seed(7402)
cases     <- unique(train$Case)
val_cases <- sample(cases, size = round(0.20 * length(cases)))
train_fit <- subset(train, !(Case %in% val_cases))
train_val <- subset(train,   Case %in% val_cases)

val_truth <- train_val$Choice
truth_mat <- matrix(0, length(val_truth), 4)
truth_mat[cbind(seq_along(val_truth), val_truth)] <- 1

attrs <- c("CC","GN","NS","BU","FA","LD","BZ","FC","FP","RP",
           "PP","KA","SC","TS","NV","MA","LB","AF","HU")

# Helper function to format data for mlogit
mk <- function(df, panel = FALSE) {
  idx <- if (panel) list(c("No","Case")) else c("No","Case")
  dfidx(df, shape = "wide", choice = "Choice",
        varying = c(4:83), sep = "", idx = idx)
}

results  <- list()
val_pred <- list()

# ==========================================
# MODEL 0: MNL Baseline (Linear Attributes)
# ==========================================
f0 <- as.formula(paste("Choice ~", paste(c(attrs, "Price"), collapse="+")))
M0 <- mlogit(f0, data = mk(train_fit))
p0 <- predict(M0, newdata = mk(train_val))
val_pred[["mnl"]] <- p0
results[["0_MNL_baseline"]] <- list(ll = log_loss(truth_mat, p0), change = "reference: linear attrs")

# ==========================================
# MODEL 1: Price Non-linearity (Price^2)
# ==========================================
f1 <- as.formula(paste("Choice ~", paste(c(attrs, "Price"), collapse="+"), "+ I(Price^2)"))
M1 <- mlogit(f1, data = mk(train_fit))
p1 <- predict(M1, newdata = mk(train_val))
val_pred[["price2"]] <- p1
results[["1_price_squared"]] <- list(ll = log_loss(truth_mat, p1), change = "added I(Price^2)")

# ==========================================
# MODEL 2: Income x Price Interaction
# ==========================================
tf <- train_fit; tv <- train_val
for (j in 1:4) {
  tf[[paste0("PxI", j)]] <- tf[[paste0("Price", j)]] * tf$incomea
  tv[[paste0("PxI", j)]] <- tv[[paste0("Price", j)]] * tv$incomea
}
S2f <- dfidx(tf, shape="wide", choice="Choice", sep="",
             varying = c(4:83, which(names(tf) %in% paste0("PxI",1:4))), idx = c("No","Case"))
S2v <- dfidx(tv, shape="wide", choice="Choice", sep="",
             varying = c(4:83, which(names(tv) %in% paste0("PxI",1:4))), idx = c("No","Case"))

f2  <- as.formula(paste("Choice ~", paste(c(attrs, "Price", "PxI"), collapse="+")))
M2  <- mlogit(f2, data = S2f)
p2  <- predict(M2, newdata = S2v)
val_pred[["income_price"]] <- p2
results[["2_income_x_price"]] <- list(ll = log_loss(truth_mat, p2), change = "Price interacts with income")

# ==========================================
# MODEL 3: Nested Logit (Real Bundles vs Opt-Out)
# ==========================================
M3 <- tryCatch(
  mlogit(f0, data = mk(train_fit), nests = list(buy = c("1","2","3"), noBuy = c("4")), un.nest.el = TRUE),
  error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(M3)) {
  p3 <- predict(M3, newdata = mk(train_val))
  val_pred[["nested"]] <- p3
  results[["3_nested_logit"]] <- list(ll = log_loss(truth_mat, p3), change = "nest: 3 real vs opt-out")
}

# ==========================================
# MODEL 4: Mixed Logit (Random Price)
# ==========================================
M4 <- tryCatch(
  mlogit(as.formula(paste("Choice ~", paste(c(attrs, "Price"), collapse="+"), "- 1")),
         data = mk(train_fit, panel = TRUE), rpar = c(Price = "n"), panel = TRUE, R = 50, halton = NA),
  error = function(e) NULL)
if (!is.null(M4)) {
  p4 <- predict(M4, newdata = mk(train_val, panel = TRUE))
  val_pred[["mixed"]] <- p4
  results[["4_mixed_logit"]] <- list(ll = log_loss(truth_mat, p4), change = "random Price coefficient")
}

# ==========================================
# MODEL 5: Ensemble (The Ultimate Winner)
# ==========================================
pick <- intersect(c("mnl", "price2", "income_price", "mixed"), names(val_pred))
ens  <- Reduce(`+`, val_pred[pick]) / length(pick)
ens  <- ens / rowSums(ens) # Normalize probabilities
results[["5_ensemble"]] <- list(ll = log_loss(truth_mat, ens), change = paste("avg of:", paste(pick, collapse=", ")))

# ==========================================
# VIEW RESULTS SUMMARY
# ==========================================
summary_tbl <- data.frame(
  model      = names(results),
  change     = sapply(results, function(x) x$change),
  cv_logloss = round(sapply(results, function(x) x$ll), 5),
  row.names  = NULL
)
summary_tbl <- summary_tbl[order(summary_tbl$cv_logloss), ]
print(summary_tbl)
```
